title: Reports
hub_hint: Every figure of the period, in both currencies — and every report can leave as an Excel file.
sales_hint: What was sold in the period, and what came in
profit_hint: Sale price less what the stock sold cost us
profit_basis: Margin against what the stock sold actually cost us
stock_hint: What is in the yard now, and what moved
receivables_hint: What each company owes us, highest first
payables_hint: What we owe companies, highest first
damage_hint: What broke, and what was paid back
employee_activity_hint: What each employee did in the period
cash_up_hint: What each employee should hand over, per currency
no_cost_price: {{count}} lines with no bought price — excluded
expenses_hint: What the factory spent besides buying stock
order_adjustment_in_totals: The totals include the orders' rounding less their discounts, which belong to a whole order and not to one material:
